venira.avoid_when: you know the path (project_read_file), want one file's structure (project_outline_symbol), a symbol's usages (project_symbol_references) or files ranked by several keywords (project_selective_search).
venira.output_kind: hits[] {relative_path, line_number, snippet}, complete, total_match_lines, files_matched. No match is ok with empty hits.
venira.speed_profile: medium (file scan); TTL cache 3s for the same query.
venira.use_when: you must locate code, strings or symbols before reading. hybrid=1 tags each hit with source and confidence.

description:
Search by kind: file_name, directory_name, literal_content (regex=1 for regex) or definition (symbol declaration lines).
Use when: you must locate code, strings or symbols before reading. hybrid=1 tags each hit with source and confidence.
Avoid when: you know the path (project_read_file), want one file's structure (project_outline_symbol), a symbol's usages (project_symbol_references) or files ranked by several keywords (project_selective_search).
Output: hits[] {relative_path, line_number, snippet}, complete, total_match_lines, files_matched. No match is ok with empty hits.

count_only.description: 1 returns only match counts; limit is then ignored. 0 (default) returns hits.

exclude_glob.description: rg glob exclusion (same dialect as glob).

glob.description: rg glob filter ('*.ts' = any depth, 'tools/*.ts' = that dir).

hybrid.description: 1 = tag hits with source/confidence; literal_content only.

include_hidden.description: 1 = include hidden files (default); 0 = skip dotfiles. Secrets always excluded.

kind.description: name substring | content (substring, or regex when regex=1) | declaration lines.

limit.description: Max hits returned (default and max 200; ignored when count_only=1).

query.description: What to find (meaning depends on kind).

regex.description: 1 treats query as a regular expression for literal_content/definition (default 0 = plain substring).

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative ('.' = root); absolute/.. outside it rejected.

whole_word.description: 1 = whole-word match only (rg -w / JS word boundaries) for literal_content and definition.

name: project_search
title: Search workspace
